_comment: Pinned plugin versions. This project is version-sensitive: Elementor 4.x
removed the [elementor-template] shortcode and the classic per-widget style
controls, and HFE's nav widget emits selectors the design system cannot
out-specify. An unpinned auto-update can therefore break the site silently.
`wp glm install` installs these exact versions. `wp glm audit` reports drift.
Bump a version here, test, then commit — the manifest is the record of what

required.name: Elementor
required.why: Page builder. Sections, header and footer are generated as Elementor templates.

required.name: Advanced Custom Fields
required.why: Fields for the tort, location and result post types. Field groups sync from acf-json/.

required.name: Header Footer Elementor
required.why: Provides the header/footer template system (R6). Its widgets are unused.

required.name: Contact Form 7
required.why: Case evaluation form. Chosen because it does not persist submissions.
